names_as_written: the giant reptiles of our secondary rocks
notes: Ambiguous: 'giant reptiles of our secondary [Mesozoic] rocks ... partly immersed in water' most plausibly refers to the large (then thought amphibious) dinosaurs, so it is resolved to Dinosauria; it could also be read as Mesozoic marine reptiles. The GBIF backbone has no Dinosauria node (species/match returns NONE) and ITIS does not list it. NCBI taxid 436486 is a clade without a Linnaean rank.
